clinicalReview: Required before activation in Epic. Not the standard of care.
title: Closed Head Injury: Initial Assessment in the Emergency Center
mission: Initial emergency assessment of a clinically stable closed head injury in the last 24 hours, under 18 years.
checkpoints: Confirm a closed injury, clinical stability, age under 18, and injury within 24 hours.
Stop for an open injury, instability, anticoagulation, a ventricular shunt, suspected non-accidental trauma under 12 months, and the pre-existing conditions the summary excludes.
Use the imaging decision aid printed in the summary.
mayPropose: An unsigned imaging ServiceRequest only when the printed decision aid selects imaging.
cardSummary: TCH closed-head-injury summary may apply. Stable, closed, under 18, within 24 hours.
